38 Special

Bozeman, MT · Road

38 Special is a road group ride in Bozeman, MT. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Kelly Canyon Rd and the I-90 frontage road, at the Kelly Canyon railroad tracks.

How we know

The Gallatin Valley Bicycle Club's weekly rides page (page last modified Mar 9, 2026) gives the 38 Special schedule as April and May Saturdays at 10 AM and June through September Saturdays at 9 AM; it is a secondary listing (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

The Gallatin Valley Bicycle Club lists this but says most rides on its list are not club rides, so check with the ride host.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: spirited; ends with a sprint at the railroad tracks sign. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 38 Special group ride

A fast Saturday road ride over Kelly Canyon Rd, up Bridger Canyon Rd and along the frontage road to the top of Bozeman Pass, then back. It is a drop ride with regroups at Bridger Canyon Rd, the top of Jackson Creek and the top of the pass.
